lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Teacher,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I have a question.
What is it?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I would appreciate it if you could respond seriously.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: As a student,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: is it really necessary for us to

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: review all the previous materials we've learned?
Absolutely. Reviewing is essential.
Not only is it necessary to review, but you've also got to prepare well in advance for any exams.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: As I thought.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I knew you would say that, Teacher.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: On that, you and I agree.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Only after you've reviewed and prepared extensively

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: can you truly say you fully understand any given lesson.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Could I ask one more thing, if it's alright?
Sure.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I want you to take this question seriously as well.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: If you were teaching a class

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: and noticed a student eating snacks,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: what would you do?
I would confiscate the snacks at once.
I'm okay with students drinking water, but nothing more.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: My thoughts exactly.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Snacking during class

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: shows a complete lack of respect for the teacher.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: So you don't consider water to be a snack?
That's correct.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Thanks for answering.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: As I expected, I won.
You won?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Ein, Rei, and I were betting on what your answer would be,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: and the winner gets to decide which dessert we'll be trying

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: at the new pastry shop that opened up near the school.
Haha, I see.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: They're both saying that I cheated since I made such a fuss about you taking the question seriously.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: But when people ask you a question, it's only right to treat it seriously, isn't that right?
That's true.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I knew it.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Anyway, thank you for the answers, Teacher.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: The others and I are off to go eat some dessert.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I'll let you know how it was.
Okay, enjoy your dessert.
